story: Tip: Don't record laser tattoo removal (2019)
text: Tattoo removal tends to use ~1MW pulsed lasers (yes, megawatt). The pulse is extremely short (nanoseconds), but at that power/instant-brightness it's enough to fry sensitive imaging electronics. Can also do fun things like blast holes through CDs. I'd learned about the topic the other day here ("plays" with a cheap tattoo removal kit off the web): [VIDEO]

More worryingly, it’s possible to buy pre-built laser etchers online that don’t come with safety glass: [LINK] And Q-switched pulse lasers for hair removal (i.e. to be aimed at your face) whose included safety goggles are more than a little suspicious: [VIDEO]
